title: Extended-Stay Dining Terms: Stay-Length Dining Uplift on Guest Folios
content:
The stay-length dining uplift of the Ashbury Rewards dining allowance on Guest Folios is an amount per person set by the length of the reservation.

**Term.** Stay-length dining uplift: a reservation of seven or more nights adds the seven-night uplift of $15.00 per person, a reservation of five or six nights adds the five-night uplift of $10.00 per person, and a shorter reservation adds nothing.

The nights are the reservation's nights as shown on the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio — the number of nights between its arrival date and its departure date.

## Uplift by length of reservation

| Nights on the Room Reservations record | Uplift per person |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | $15.00 |
| 5 or 6 | $10.00 |
| 4 or fewer | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical reservations)

| Nights | Against the thresholds of 5 and 7 nights | Uplift per person |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Below 5 | None |
| 5 | At 5 | $10.00 |
| 6 | Below 7 | $10.00 |
| 7 | At 7 | $15.00 |
| 12 | Above 7 | $15.00 |

The uplift is an amount per person: with two dining persons, a seven-night reservation adds $15.00 for each of them.
